title: Deep Fair Learning: A Unified Framework for Fine-tuning Representations with Sufficient Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring True Positive Rate (TPR) gaps and Maximal Cumulative Ratio Disparity along Predictions (MCDP) gaps between male and female groups across multiple tasks: income prediction (Adult dataset), biography occupation classification (BIOS dataset), and facial attribute prediction (CelebA dataset).
Evaluating TPR and MCDP gaps between different age groups (categorized as over or under 25) in a bank deposit subscription prediction task (Bank dataset).
Measuring TPR and MCDP gaps between tweets annotated as African-American versus Standard American English in a sentiment classification task (MOJI dataset).

Calculating TPR and MCDP gaps across phenotypic sensitive attributes, specifically skin color (pale skin or not) and hair color (black hair or not), in a facial image attribute prediction task (CelebA dataset).
